name: UNBench
reported_size: GitHub: about 30 samples per task; full release separate
raw_format: CSV + nested JSON + draft JSON/PDF folders
raw_fields_or_structure: task2.csv: Country,Original_id,Authors,Voting,Date. task4.json: Date,ID,Title,Authors,Content,Statements[{representative,country,statement}]. Draft JSON: Date,ID,Title,Authors,Content.
recommended_use: Vote SFT; statement SFT; frozen held-out evaluation
main_caveat: task2 needs draft join; task4 includes post-vote speech; overlapping UN corpora. GitHub sample is not the full corpus.
rights_note: Repo MIT; underlying UN material requires separate review.
acquisition: Clone repo for samples. Full archive is linked from README via Google Drive.

name: UNSC Meetings and Speeches
raw_fields_or_structure: Article describes 23 meeting variables and speaker/affiliation/role fields. Exact TSV headers NOT inspected.
recommended_use: Main country-conditioned speech pool; context reconstruction; optional domain adaptation
main_caveat: Separate national representative, Council president, UN official, and organization roles. Older OCR needs checking.
rights_note: Dataset-specific terms not verified; article licence is not sufficient.
acquisition: Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/CKPTRB; automated access blocked in this inspection.

name: UN Security Council Debates
raw_format: Author-hosted tabular corpus; raw files not opened
raw_fields_or_structure: Speaker affiliation, date and within-meeting sequence documented; exact headers pending.
recommended_use: Alternative to D02; country coverage audit
main_caveat: Overlaps D02 and UNBench. Do not sum counts or concatenate without deduplication.
rights_note: Release terms pending verification.
acquisition: Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/KGVSYH.

name: UNGA Speech Corpus — Speaking Volumes
raw_format: ZIP linked from author research page; member files not inspected
raw_fields_or_structure: Country-labelled General Assembly speech records; exact schema pending.
recommended_use: Broader institutional coverage, especially non-P5 countries
main_caveat: Not the annual General Debate corpus; exact download structure and rights require inspection.
rights_note: Not verified.
acquisition: Author page links UNGA-Speech-Corpus-Data.zip on Dropbox.

name: United Nations General Debate Corpus (UNGDC)
reported_size: Published corpus: over 10,000 speeches; exact current count not audited
raw_format: UTF-8 TXT in tar.gz; filename convention country_session_year.txt
raw_fields_or_structure: Example filename pattern: ISO3_session_year.txt. Country/session/year parseable; exact speech date needs a metadata join.
recommended_use: Diplomatic language adaptation; country/topic summaries; grounded QA
main_caveat: Annual statements are not dialogue. Do not infer precise date from year. Importer release count is not a verified download.
rights_note: Verify exact Dataverse release terms.
acquisition: Dataverse; documented file ID 13591895, UNGDC_1946-2025.tar.gz; access not tested successfully.

name: Official UN General Assembly Voting Data
raw_fields_or_structure: Importer reads undl_id,ms_code,ms_name,ms_vote,meeting,draft,resolution and other metadata. Direct CSV header was not fetched.
recommended_use: Recorded-vote prediction; country similarity controls; join to resolution text
main_caveat: Only adopted resolutions with recorded votes; excludes failed drafts and paragraph votes. X/non-voting is not abstention.
rights_note: UN metadata: non-commercial use with attribution; do not equate public access with unrestricted reuse.
acquisition: Official Files tab; direct CSV URL in secondary link.

name: Official UN Security Council Voting Data
coverage: Official longitudinal release; inspect current coverage metadata
raw_fields_or_structure: Importer reads vote fields analogous to D06 and permanent_member. Direct CSV header pending.
recommended_use: UNSC vote labels and linked decision tasks
main_caveat: Germany is not P5; only evaluate a country in periods where it actually has the relevant voting role. Audit coverage of failed drafts.
rights_note: Check this release separately; do not assume terms from D06.
acquisition: Official Files tab.

name: Official General Debate speech metadata
raw_fields_or_structure: Importer documents Name,Salutation,Member State,GA Session,Meeting Date,Meeting Symbol,Agenda Items,UNDL ID,UNDL Link.
recommended_use: Attach speaker, document and exact date to annual speeches
main_caveat: Metadata only: not the full speech text. Check one-to-many joins.
rights_note: Release-specific terms pending.
acquisition: Official record; direct access failed in this environment.

name: Chinese MFA Press Conferences Corpus
raw_format: Tabular corpus on Dataverse; file type/headers not inspected
raw_fields_or_structure: Paper describes question, answer, date, spokesperson, original/split IDs, linguistic variants/entities. Literal header names pending.
recommended_use: Real spokesperson QA SFT; topic-conditioned responses
main_caveat: Use original text, not lemmatized variants. Press spokesperson is not identical to UN delegate; label institutional role. Official edited records are not private deliberation.
rights_note: Dataset terms pending; do not infer from article licence.
acquisition: Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/BAKGET; robot check prevented file inspection.

name: Chinese MFA current press-conference archive
raw_fields_or_structure: Page title, publication timestamp, journalist/outlet questions, spokesperson answers; requires transcript parser.
recommended_use: Extend D09 temporally; dated retrieval; real multi-turn follow-ups
main_caveat: Deduplicate embassy/consulate mirrors. Keep questions grouped within one conference and preserve follow-up context.
rights_note: Check source terms and permitted collection rates.
acquisition: Crawl dated transcript links; do not scrape personal contact blocks.

main_caveat: Check speaking capacity; exclude boilerplate and duplicates of UN transcripts.
rights_note: Source terms pending.

rights_note: Source terms pending.

name: German government press conferences
coverage: Dated official archive; current examples inspected
raw_fields_or_structure: Question / follow-up labels and speaker-labelled answers; identify ministry, e.g. AA for Foreign Office. No bulk schema verified.
recommended_use: German foreign-policy QA; robustness to follow-up questions
main_caveat: Do not label all government answers as Foreign Office or UN policy. Keep German distinct from any translated English derivative.
rights_note: Verify transcript reuse terms.
acquisition: Collect official transcripts; filter relevant ministry and topics.

name: UPR Info recommendations database
reported_size: Interface displayed 122,743 recommendations; not a downloaded row count
raw_format: Web database with CSV export button
raw_fields_or_structure: Visible labels: Recommendation ID,Cycle,Session,State under Review,Recommendation,Recommending State,Action Category,Response,Issues,Date added. Exact CSV headers pending.
recommended_use: Recommend as country A to country B; predict B’s supported/noted response; multi-agent tasks
main_caveat: Given vs received recommendations differ. Date added is ingestion time. Supported/noted is not implementation.
rights_note: No blanket dataset licence verified; review UPR Info terms.
acquisition: Use filtered export; snapshot query, export time and counts. No automated export was run.

name: OHCHR Universal Human Rights Index (UHRI)
coverage: UPR + Treaty Bodies + Special Procedures; updated over time
raw_format: Full JSON and Excel downloads; documented REST API access by contact
raw_fields_or_structure: Export schemas not inspected; retain mechanism, country, originating entity, recommendation and source document.
recommended_use: Official alternative/addition to D14; mechanism-specific task construction
main_caveat: Filter UPR for country-to-country tasks. Other mechanisms are not national delegates. OHCHR notes processing gaps.
rights_note: Our Data page says freely shared; read Terms of Usage and retain provenance.
acquisition: Direct JSON/Excel links on page; API documentation available from uhrisupport@ohchr.org.
